title: goome ui builder project
description: a .goome.json from the goome ui builder, https://goome-ui.github.io/docs/builder/

type.description: a widget type from the builder

knob_size.description: builder range 2 to 20, slider knob radius

item_h.description: builder range 0 to 64, every widget row, 0 = from the font

menu_item_h.description: builder range 0 to 64, 0 = from the font

tab_h.description: builder range 0 to 64, 0 = from the font

win_title_h.description: builder range 0 to 64, 0 = from the font

app_title_h.description: builder range 0 to 64, 0 = from the font

menubar_h.description: builder range 0 to 64, 0 = from the font

statusbar_h.description: builder range 0 to 64, 0 = from the font

spinner.description: builder range 0 to 64, 0 = from the font

caret_w.description: builder range 0 to 16, 0 = thin, go wide for a block

heading_size.description: builder range 0 to 48, 0 = font size x 1.3

small_size.description: builder range 0 to 28, 0 = from the font

hover_ms.description: builder range -1 to 600, below 0 follows anim_ms

press_ms.description: builder range -1 to 600, below 0 follows anim_ms

popup_ms.description: builder range -1 to 600, below 0 follows anim_ms

collapse_ms.description: builder range -1 to 600, below 0 follows anim_ms

toast_fade_ms.description: builder range -1 to 1000, below 0 follows anim_ms

font_heading.description: system font name, empty = the ui font

font_mono.description: system font name, empty = the ui font

font_small.description: system font name, empty = the ui font

focus_on_mouse.description: focus ring after a mouse click too
